scenario: the first practical exchange about health services & pharmacy
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Health Services and Pharmacy
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: health services & pharmacy — the first practical exchange about health services & pharmacy
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about health services & pharmacy; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr David for bandages at a pharmacy.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi anh David mua băng gạc tại nhà thuốc.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, David. Do you have bandages?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh David. Ở đây có băng gạc không?

turns.speaker: Mr David
turns.vietnamese: Chị giữ gìn sức khỏe nhé.
